title: Fourth density-split transition, separate sources
description: Extends Rohan Arun’s accepted third density-split proof (PR 84) to the exact boundary 873981/1000000 = 0.873981, with the principal pole excluded. The fourth transition starts from G(99/100, 239/100, 1/10) and uses separate physical-source and count children while retaining the parent capped-count branch. Its scalar source gates and density floor have exact Bernstein certificates; the final all-shift return at h = 16109/20000 uses 29 certified admission windows and 91 exact four-edge rectangle certificates. The analytic framework and inherited source/return machinery are credited to OpenAI, Sil, Hailey Collet, ArviFoxy, and Rohan Arun; inherited license and authorship notices remain. The fourth-step research, certificate generation, and Lean integration were substantially AI-assisted by Codex (OpenAI).
